decisions.reason: The source changes the hero's visual asset and supporting media, but does not change the established headline or explanatory copy.
The source adds details to the independently represented hero visualization; the broader landing-page content mix remains valid, and multiple images can satisfy its existing general image inclusion.
Requesting an AI-generated product-layout image does not change the site's clean, minimal SaaS style, reference, or brand-colour source.
The hero media request does not change the Webflow platform, hosting configuration, or selected site plan.
